reply_text: Noted, June. I won't post the Pellucid Amendment 2 rate ($2,015 a seat) in any Coastal channel or in anyone else's DM. I'll also keep it out of mail and calendar entries unless you or Anselm approve it for a specific recipient. If you want me to draft something for Pellucid, tell me what it needs and I'll leave the rate out unless it can go to you, Anselm, or the account owner.
